title: a render died inside the workflow: index is out of bounds for dimension with size 0 (09-21 11:16Z)
evidence: 1 ComfyUI execution error(s) in the last 24h; newest index is out of bounds for dimension with size 0 (09-21 11:16Z). The producer now NAMES this (Growth::ContentGenerator carries the ComfyUI error into the run's failure reason and the brain's decision row) instead of reporting every render death as a timeout, and it RE-SUBMITS once on a node exception (a fresh seed -- seed = the run's base seed + the new ComfyuiJob id -- so the retry draws a different sample). A retry that RECOVERS still leaves this failed row, so read this entry as 'the workflow can die on this input', not as 'a render was lost'. The fault itself is the workflow payload (an empty CLIPSeg head/hand mask reaching the WAS 'Bounded Image Crop with Mask' node), not the Rails code. Reconciled orphans are excluded.

notes.note: 2026-09-21 11:4xZ ops-triage: ROOT CAUSE identified from the ComfyUI log, and the LOSS OF CAUSE fixed in-repo. What happened: the 07:00 EDT growth tick claimed 17GiB (the adaptive-fit fix worked: claim granted in 0s), rendered 3 prompts (412s/295s/174s) and lost the third -- run 479 / ComfyuiJob 7563 failed at 11:16:30Z with "index is out of bounds for dimension with size 0" raised at WAS_Node_Suite.py:12405 bounded_image_crop_with_mask (rmin, rmax = torch.where(rows)[0][[0, -1]]) -- the workflow Bounded Image Crop with Mask node received an EMPTY CLIPSeg head mask (node 16 ApplyCLIPSeg+ prompt "head" -> node 45 GrowMaskWithBlur -> crop), so torch.where returned no indices. The tick then recorded cadence_blocked "Could not top up queue: render timed out or produced no image (run 479)" and released the GPU. Two distinct faults: (a) the workflow/input fault itself (empty head mask) lives in the DB pipeline payload turbo-one-step-clean -- NOT in this repo, needs a GPU-owning session or Tim; (b) the ATTRIBUTION fault, fixed here: Growth::ContentGenerator reported a node exception as a timeout, so the cause reached neither the brain decision row nor this board. FIX (packs/growth_harness/app/services/growth/content_generator.rb): poll_for_image now captures the ComfyUI error (client payload, falling back to the ComfyuiJob error_message written by PollJobStatus) into render_error, and generate_one writes "render failed in ComfyUI: <error>" to the run reject_reason and the returned error. VERIFIED: 2 new specs in spec/services/growth/content_generator_spec.rb (names-the-error end-to-end through the real poll path; falls back to the job record and tolerates an unknown job) -- 5 examples 0 failures; cadence_engine + render_salvage specs 16 examples 0 failures. This probe entry self-closes 24h after the last execution error.

2026-09-21 12:3xZ ops-triage: CONTAINED in-repo; root cause still the workflow payload. New evidence: this is NOT a new regression -- ComfyuiJob rows with this exact error number 260 all-time, in bursts (211 on 2025-12-10, 36 on 2025-12-11, 12 on 2026-05-26, 1 on 2026-09-21), so the WAS "Bounded Image Crop with Mask" node has been able to die on an empty CLIPSeg head/hand mask for a year. FIX (commit 81e8c4a): Growth::ContentGenerator re-submits ONCE when a poll fails with a ComfyUI error (never on a plain no-image timeout), and the seed is pipeline_run.variables[seed] + comfyui_job.id (SubmitJob#apply_job_variables), so the retry draws a genuinely different sample; bounded to one so a deterministically failing prompt fails the run instead of looping -- the policy PollJobStatus already applies to a retryable OOM. VERIFIED: rspec spec/services/growth 72 examples 0 failures; NEGATIVE CONTROL -- disabling the retry fails the new spec (submits 1, expected 2). The probe evidence text now states that a RECOVERED retry still leaves the failed row, so this entry means "the workflow can die on this input", not "a render was lost". STILL BLOCKED on the payload itself (empty mask reaching the crop node): the workflow lives in pipeline_steps.comfy_workflow_json (step 40 / pipeline 21 turbo-one-step-clean) and a robustness change there needs a GPU-owning session to verify, which this run does not hold. No claim taken, no render run.

The workflow lives only in pipeline_steps.comfy_workflow_json (no repo file), so the payload fix needs a GPU-owning session. DECISION 2026-09-21 (operating agent, route=agent): ACCEPT the containment; do NOT escalate. The single bounded re-submit (81e8c4a) fits the observed rate -- 260 rows all-time in bursts (211 on 2025-12-10, 36 on 12-11, 12 on 2026-05-26, 1 on 2026-09-21) -- and cannot loop because the retry is bounded to one. The deeper fix (pre-empting an empty CLIPSeg mask before the WAS Bounded Image Crop node indexes its bbox) is AGENT work in the DB payload, not a Tim ask; it needs a GPU-owning session to verify, so it stays blocked-on-slot and is not escalated. Commit 81e8c4a (retry-once + naming the ComfyUI error) is dated 2026-09-21 08:46:38 -0400 = 12:46Z; run 479 failed at 11:16:30Z with reject_reason 'render timed out or produced no image' and growth_decisions.cadence_blocked at 11:16:35Z -- both ~1.5h BEFORE the fix, which is exactly the pre-fix behaviour the commit describes, so today's row does NOT contradict the containment.
